meta.title: SkillStack — certification planning that fits your week
meta.description: Pick an IT certification, get a study plan built around the hours you actually have, and put it in your calendar.

hero.title: Pick a certification. Get a plan that fits your week.
hero.body: SkillStack looks at your experience and the hours you actually have, then builds a study plan you can keep — and puts it in your calendar.

advisor.title: An advisor that will talk you out of it
advisor.body: Answer a few questions about your background and goals. It tells you whether a certification is worth your time, and says so plainly when it isn't.

plans.title: Plans built around your real week
plans.body: Week-by-week topics paced to the hours you have, not an idealised schedule you'll abandon by day four.

resources.title: Resources worth your time
resources.body: Official docs, courses and practice exams for each certification, with the free ones marked as free.

calendar.title: Sessions in your calendar
calendar.body: Study sessions and your exam date go straight into Google Calendar. Re-sync updates them instead of duplicating.

progress.title: Progress you can trust
progress.body: Completed topics, current streak, and an honest read on whether you're ready to sit the exam.

catalog.title: One place to compare
catalog.body: Certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, CompTIA, Cisco, PMI and others — cost, difficulty and study time side by side.

step1.title: Choose a certification
step1.body: Filter by category, difficulty, cost and study time. Each one shows what it leads to and what it pays.

step2.title: Talk to the advisor
step2.body: It asks about your experience, your budget and how much time you have, then drafts a plan and explains its reasoning.

step3.title: Study and track
step3.body: Work through weekly topics, tick them off, and watch the readiness estimate move.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.body: Pick a certification and get a plan in a few minutes.

footer.tagline: Certification planning for people with jobs.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languages: Languages you can take an exam in
profile.lede: The advisor reads this before it asks you anything. Whatever is filled in here, it will not ask about again — so the more of it is honest, the shorter the conversation and the better the plan fits.
profile.jobRoleHint: What you do now. The advisor uses it to judge how big a jump a certification is for you.
profile.careerGoalPlaceholder: Move into a cloud engineering role
profile.careerGoalHint: Where you want to end up. Be specific — "a better job" gives the advisor nothing to reason with.
profile.experienceLevelHint: Roughly where you are across IT in general, not with one product.
profile.dailyStudyTimeHint: On a day you actually study. Half hours are fine (1.5). Your plan is paced to this number, so an optimistic one buys you a plan you will miss.
profile.weeklyAvailabilityHint: 0 to 7. Days you will realistically open a book, not days you intend to.
profile.budgetHint: US dollars, for courses, books and practice exams. Not the exam fee itself — that is listed on each certification. Enter 0 and you will only ever be shown free resources.
profile.preferredFormatsHint: The kinds of resource you learn best from. The advisor leans toward these when it builds your plan — it won't refuse a great resource in another format, it just prefers yours when it can.
profile.preferredSitesHint: Sites you'd rather learn from. Same rule: a nudge, not a filter. Leave both empty and the advisor picks purely on fit.
profile.skillsHint: Things you can already do — Linux, Python, networking, Docker. Set a level so the advisor knows how deep you are, and spends less time on what you already know.
profile.languagesHint: Spoken languages, not programming ones. Not every certification is offered in every language, and the advisor will tell you when this one is not.

settings.title: Settings

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.body: How the advisor talks to you and paces your plans. It stays honest at every setting — this only changes the delivery.
advisor.toneHint: Direct is blunt and minimal; warm is encouraging and personable.
advisor.lengthHint: Brief keeps replies to a few sentences; detailed spells things out.
advisor.questionsHint: Few gets to the plan fast; thorough interviews you first.
advisor.intensityHint: Relaxed paces gently; intense packs in a demanding schedule.

settings.languageBody: Changes the interface and the advisor's replies.
settings.currencyBody: The currency exam prices are shown in.
settings.calendarBody: Let SkillStack add study sessions to your calendar.
settings.dangerBody: Removes your profile, plans and progress. This can't be undone.
